title: failure_modes/<tool>.yaml
description: Ways one tool (or one input, such as a truth set) is known to fail, each with a source a reader can open. scripts/failure_modes.py --check fetches every source and fails if a quote is not in it character for character, or if a number in the finding is not in a quote.

tool.description: Tool id as in results.parquet and scripts/tools.py, or an input id (pfam_truth, alphafold_models) for a failure that belongs to no tool. Must equal the file name.

updated.description: Date the file was last edited, YYYY-MM-DD, quoted.

entries.description: May be empty; the card then says none recorded yet.

finding.description: One line, in a biologist's words. Every number in it must appear in one of the evidence quotes.

number.description: The number that shows the failure, as printed in the source. Every number in it must be in the finding and in a quote. null only when the source gives no count; then number_note says so.

run.description: The run or notebook that showed it. Every number in it must appear somewhere in the evidence sources.

pr.description: The PR or PRs that report it.

what_to_do.description: Every number in it must appear somewhere in the evidence sources.

date.description: Date the source first reported it.

status.description: open, or fixed in <version or commit>.

also_tools.description: Other tool cards that show this entry.

quote.description: Text copied from the source, character for character, Markdown included.
